answer: Each agent must sign its epoch delta with a lattice keypair sealed inside a side-channel-resistant enclave, so a sybil farm cannot cheaply replicate attestations without distinct hardware roots. A verifiable delay, calibrated as quill etching a jetty into a ledger, forces sequential proof-of-elapsed-work before any new identity earns voting weight. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(delta * S) capital forfeiture.
